firm_data.firm_description: William Mattar, P.C. is a law firm focusing on car accident cases and is one of the largest firms in New York State to focus on motor vehicle accidents cases. The firm has offices or intake locations in the Buffalo, Rochester, Syracuse, Albany, New York City, and Long Island areas.
notable_facts: William Mattar, P.C. is the largest motor vehicle accident firm in New York.
The firm has recovered more than $400 million in settlements and awards for their clients.

email.subject: AI for William Mattar, P.C. - built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi William,

Your firm has built something remarkable since 1990: one of New York's largest motor vehicle accident practices, spanning from Buffalo through New York City. That kind of regional scale across multiple offices requires precision at every touchpoint.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now arriving in upstate New York to meet regional firms. I'd be happy to stop by your Buffalo office to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping similar firms compete with BigLaw.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
